method: Actual production Panel and Qt button events, native scenegraph and disposable FCStd evaluation; hidden independent process with no assistant server.
limits: Synthetic small fixtures. Native renderer automatically adjusts near/far clipping to displayed scene geometry; camera invariance checks retain position/orientation/focus/zoom while excluding those clipping distances. Palette and rendered-glyph checks plus screenshots do not replace Kurt's visual/comfort acceptance. Native notification is triggered with an isolated console warning; the original face-selection popup's exact trigger is not asserted. Native C++ networking and physical offline operation are not intercepted.
